cells.tense: The pattern is being read and the reading is being trusted.
cells.ask: Pick one decision you have been holding open and say out loud what you actually expect to happen. Let someone hear it.
cells.core:
You are reading the pattern and you know you are reading it. The shapes in the noise are not guesses — they land, you check them, they hold. And when you move through something unclear you do not need the whole road mapped. One step of light is enough and you take it.

What keeps this honest is that it stays yours. The pull of what other people might feel runs alongside the reading — you sense it, and it does not get to make the call. That is the balance: sharp sight, still connected to the people it touches, not swallowed by either one. The cost of keeping it is attention. Say what you notice before you act on it and the call stays yours.

cells.tense: You are bracing for a version of this that has not arrived yet.
cells.ask: Name the one thing you are most sure of right now. Then send the next message or take the next step without re-checking the whole picture first.
cells.core:
The reading is running ahead of the situation. You have already worked out how it goes, what they will say, where it breaks — and you are organizing yourself around a version that has not happened. When the read arrives before the situation does, the read starts making the decisions.

What is behind this is real: you can see patterns that most people miss, and that sight is a gift. But there is a difference between seeing a pattern and forcing one into place. The clarity you are pushing for is not sharper than the clarity you already have. Put the next thing in front of someone as it stands. Let the shape that holds be the one the situation gives you, not the one you brought.

cells.tense: The pattern was there once and the reading of it stopped somewhere back.
cells.ask: Tell one person about something you noticed recently — a pattern, a coincidence, a thing that clicked. Just tell it. Do not make it useful.
cells.core:
You used to read this well. The reading went quiet somewhere back, and now things arrive without shape. Not because you cannot see — the reading itself is still in you — but because the light is on something else and this part of you is running cold.

What feeds it back is not effort, it is contact. Meaning that moves between people, teaching that stays alive, belonging that does not demand you become someone else. That is the way back: not pushing yourself to see again, but standing close to something that means something to someone and letting it move through you. The reading returns when there is something worth reading for.

cells.tense: The reading is already happening and it is being called something else.
cells.ask: Pick one time this week you read a situation right and called it luck or instinct. Say the word 'I' in front of it.
cells.core:
You already do this. You walk into a room and read it in a second — who is holding back, where the tension is, what will land and what will not. You call it instinct, or being good with people, or just paying attention. The reading is happening. You are just not signing it.

The pull toward what other people might feel is part of the machinery. You gather the possibilities before you speak, and that gathering is why what you say usually fits. That is not a trick and it is not an accident. It is a real thing you do, and no credit is going to the one doing it. Name it once and the rest of it gets easier to trust.
